Docker can't run properly due to permission issues with iptables/nftables. This is a container-in-container issue where we don't have the necessary privileges to run Docker.

Let me check if there's a Redis running somewhere else or if we can install Redis directly:

action.command: netstat -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep 6379 || ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep 6379 || echo "Port 6379 not listening"
